summary: The web app is easier to read, and its buttons make clear what each action does.

new.title: Larger text and bigger buttons
new.text: Text in the web app is larger and the buttons are bigger, so every page is easier to read.

new.title: Risky actions stand out in red
new.text: The main action on each page is the filled button. Actions that write or remove something, such as Discard all or Disable, are red.

new.title: Clearer commit queue and policy pages
new.text: The commit queue names each field in words, and a policy page shows its current stage as a marker.

new.title: Smaller layout and wording improvements
new.text: The selected rule's panel stays in view, Settings highlights Save after a change, long explanations fold behind Read more, and Conditional Access groups say 'not read yet' instead of 0.
